_comment: gygax-designed deck-adaptation variants (2026-06-22, cabt-deck-design room). 4 single-axis, bot-friendly swaps off the 754.9 Dwebble/Crustle PB, each probing a DIFFERENT meta-hypothesis so the PATTERN of results is diagnostic. All verified vs EN_Card_Data.csv, net 60, legal, energy>=27 (preserves the 3-energy floor Superb Scissors + Jumbo both need). Structural finding: Crustle's Mysterious Rock Inn ability does NOTHING vs {ex} attackers + the line is {R}-weak with only a 120 non-gust attack.

variants.name: crustle-exbelt
variants.rationale: PATCH THE {ex} BLIND SPOT (V2, strongest read): Maximum Belt +50 to {ex} → Superb Scissors hits 170, one-shots most 2-prize ex attackers. Crustle's wall ability is explicitly null vs {ex}; this flips our worst class. Falsifiable: if field is non-ex, Belt is inert → score moves <15.

variants.name: crustle-boss
variants.rationale: GUST THE WALL (V1, anti-stall/Alakazam): Boss's Orders drags the soft benched threat up to Superb-Scissors it — converts a stall into a prize vs decks that wall the active + build on the bench. Falsifiable: if meta is a pure damage-race, Boss is dead tempo → holds or dips <=20.

variants.name: crustle-pivotheal
variants.rationale: ANTI-ATTRITION (V3): Switch (free retreat off the brutal 2-3 cost) + Poke Vital A (150 heal, NO energy gate, unlike Jumbo's 3-energy req). Answers a chip/status/poison grind. Falsifiable: if meta is alpha-strike burst (KO before heal matters), heal/pivot is irrelevant → holds.

variants.name: crustle-lean
variants.rationale: VARIANCE NULL-CONTROL (V4): 31E is over-floored (attacker needs 3); Lacey (shuffle-draw 4, or 8 if behind) refuels over marginal Mist. If THIS moves the needle, the erosion is INTERNAL variance, not an external tech counter (Variants 1-3 chasing a ghost). If flat, the counter is real + external.
